invariants.rationale: writeClient is immediately dereferenced by method calls in the method body.
instantTime is passed to writeClient and likely expected to be a meaningful, non-empty string.
preppedRecordInputs is used as a parameter; a null value would likely result in an exception.
bulkInsertPartitioner is passed to downstream methods, so it should not be null (Option type may be empty but not null).
preppedRecordInputs is a List<HoodieRecord>, so when not empty, elements should be instances of HoodieRecord.
